subject: Strategy checkpoint: reprioritization requests and dependency commitments
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Park <emma@fjord-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategy checkpoint: reprioritization requests and dependency commitments

Team —

Quick mid-quarter checkpoint ahead of the QBR. I pulled a high-level snapshot of our product OKRs and highlighted a few asks where leadership alignment will materially change delivery for the next 6 weeks. TL;DR: two product stretch items should be de-prioritized into backlog unless we can lock two cross-functional dependencies this week.

OKR snapshot (high level):
- Reduce avg token latency (OKR-PI-01): On track for infra perf work but still 18% behind target at current seq lengths (RAG: Amber).
- Model onboarding throughput (OKR-MO-02): Blocked by eval infra and a missing quantized model in the catalog (RAG: Red).
- Cost/unit improvements via caching (OKR-COST-03): On track but low confidence on rollout timeline (RAG: Green/Amber).

Immediate asks for leadership:
1) Approve temporary scope backfill: move "multi-tenant quantized onboarding" out of next sprint and replace with "eval infra stabilization" (owner: Applied ML).
2) Commit two infra tickets for latency fixes (SUP-4521, SUP-4580) as P0 for the Dedicated fleet during QBR week. Need sign-off from infra leadership for reserved cycles.
3) Authorize a small budget reallocation to external eval support (Ops-Consult) for a 3-week contract to unblock model validation.

Why this matters for QBR: if we do not resolve eval infra + latency commits we risk a product ask from a top prospect (Fjord Analytics) during QBR that we cannot quantify with confidence.

Actions I propose this week:
- Leadership call Tues to decide scope swap (30 min).
- Triage owners confirm ticket ownership by EOD Wed.
- Marissa to pull a cost delta for the three-week external contract.

Attachment: OKR_snapshot_aug2026.csv (summary metrics).

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy checkpoint: reprioritization requests and dependency commitments

+1 on the proposed scope swap. A few clarifying notes:

- On SUP-4521 and SUP-4580: I need a list of exact infra resources required (GPU hours, node reservation windows). If we are asking for reserved cycles during QBR week it impacts other ded customers. Please map out the minimal reservation and alternate fallback windows.
- External contract: please include acceptance criteria for the Ops-Consult engagement (deliverables & acceptance tests).
- Let's keep Fjord in the loop but not as a blocker; Emma, we'll update you post-call.

I'm available Tue 11:00–11:45 for the 30-min leadership call.

—Lauren
Head of Product

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@ops-consult.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy checkpoint: reprioritization requests and dependency commitments

I reviewed the tickets and spoke with Infra. Quick status:
- SUP-4521 (KV cache hotpath + kernel swap): infra can take this but requires a dedicated maintenance window (4 hours) and a canary deployment slice. We can schedule for the week of Aug 24, but to make it P0 for QBR week (Aug 31) we'd need a hard reservation by EOD Fri 8/7.
- SUP-4580 (scheduler tuning for continuous batching): lower risk but needs a test harness (Jenkins job) that infra does not presently have on the Dedicated fleet. Estimated delivery 10 business days from start.

Implications and ask:
- If leadership wants SUP-4521 accelerated, we should free up the 4-hour maintenance window now by moving a lower-priority backup job out of the same reserved pool. I need a named owner who will commit to shifting that backup job.
- I'll open a Jira child (SUP-4521A) to track the canary and will link to SUP-4521.

Linking ticket: JIRA-ISSUE: SUP-4521.

Vivek
VP, Engineering Operations

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Park <emma@fjord-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy checkpoint: reprioritization requests and dependency commitments

Notes from today's call (summary & owners):

Decision: proceed with scope swap — move multi-tenant quantized onboarding to backlog, prioritize eval infra stabilization and SUP-4521 as P0. Rationale: unblock Fjord trial and ensure we can present concrete perf numbers at QBR.

Owners and immediate next steps:
- Eval infra stabilization: Applied ML (owner: Marissa) — Marissa, please post a short runbook + acceptance criteria in the Drive doc by EOD Fri 8/7. Attachment: QBR_prep_deck_v3.pdf (draft slides).
- SUP-4521 scheduling: Vivek — confirm maintenance window reservation by EOD Fri 8/7 (we need that for the canary). Vivek noted he will create SUP-4521A and link to the parent.
- Ops-Consult contract: Marissa to get SOW and cost delta; procurement looped (procurement@ops-consult.com).

Risks called out:
1) If infra cannot commit the maintenance window, we revert to a reduced-scope demo for Fjord (no KV hotpath changes).
2) External contract delays + legal redlines could push validation past QBR.

Emma — thanks for staying flexible. We'll send a brief note to Fjord with the revised scope and a targeted demo date (tentative: week of Sep 7).

Forwarding the updated deck and the CSV snapshot for QBR prep.

Confirming: I have posted the runbook (Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBRPrepDeck) and uploaded the SOW draft from Ops-Consult in the shared folder. Cost delta for a 3-week engagement is $38,500 (not including any premium for expedited legal review).

Two asks for leadership before we proceed:
- Lauren: please confirm approval to reallocate the budget (I can move the line items if you approve).
- Vivek: once the maintenance window is reserved I'll publish the canary schedule into SUP-4521A and coordinate with Applied ML for the cutover test.

Risks added to the doc: potential demo scope shrink if canary fails, and a 1-week slippage if legal requests changes to the SOW.
